Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Lorar Amaren: 33-year-old woman, 196 cm (very-tall), clearly muscular construction with readable shoulders, back, legs, and forearms, skin value band-2-light. Face: angular diamond face; large hooded eyes and a broken brow line; flat broad nose, defined cupid's bow; faint freckles. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blue-teal, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: sculpted edge pattern. Wardrobe: quilted-outerwear, specifically lightly quilted cloth outerwear over a simple fitted layer and tapered trousers; offset closures and narrow reinforced cuffs; bounded palette moss-ivory. Visible personal details: three hair rings. Make one clasp, buckle, piercing, or piece of hair hardware the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: low-maintenance grooming with highly polished footwear. Color treatment: uses small rhythmic repeats of the palette. Pose cue: weight settles into one heel, shoulders square, hands relaxed and completely visible. Include a clay tea token only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
